name: A Donation of Wool
summary: At Ironforge, wool donations help support its stores. Sixty pieces bring full recognition for your generosity.

sections.title: Wool Stores
sections.body: Ironforge asks you for sixty pieces of wool cloth. Its stores need only that much from you. Others are expected to give enough to support the drive.

faq.q: How much wool does Ironforge need from me?
faq.answer: Sixty pieces of wool cloth, for Ironforge.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: Give Ironforge sixty pieces of wool cloth, and you earn full recognition for your generosity.
Ironforge gathers wool cloth to support its stores.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, your wool donation earns recognition from Ironforge.
